//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// KernelDeclOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def MOGG_KernelDeclOp
    : MOGG_Op<"kernel.decl", [SymbolName, SymbolVisibility, Symbol]> {
  let summary = "Declares a Mojo kernel's signatures inline in the module";
  let description = [{
    Holds the signatures of a Mojo kernel struct registered under an MO op
    name. Several decls may share a `registration` (e.g. per-device
    implementations). A user-defined decl (`is_user_defined`) overrides
    built-ins with the same registration. The shape function lives in a
    separate `mogg.shape_func.decl`.

    `build_graph` has the same tensor signature as `execute` but takes a
    `DeviceGraphBuilder` in place of the `DeviceContext`.

    `execute_device` and `execute_configuration` make a declarative kernel:
    `execute_device` is the device code, taking the operands but no context,
    and `execute_configuration` is a host function over the same operands
    returning its launch configuration: any value with `get_grid_dim()` and
    `get_block_dim()`, as NeoDriver's `GridBlockExecutionConfig` has. The graph
    compiler writes the launch itself. A kernel has either `execute` or
    `execute_device`.

    `reduction` marks a `ReduceOp` monoid (see `#mogg.kernel_reduction`).

    `supports_unfused_execute` records a second `execute` overload that takes
    every fused output as a plain `Tensor` output, which the graph compiler
    calls when nothing is fused into any of them. The overload is not stored:
    `ImportPackages` checks it against `execute` and drops it, and
    `ConformCallOperands` derives the plain output contracts from `execute`.
    Grandfathered kernels only; see `kUnfusedExecuteRegistrations`.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    SymbolNameAttr:$sym_name,
    StrAttr:$registration,
    M_DeviceInfoAttr:$registration_device_info,
    OptionalAttr<MOGG_KernelFunctionAttr>:$execute,
    OptionalAttr<MOGG_KernelFunctionAttr>:$elementwise,
    OptionalAttr<MOGG_KernelFunctionAttr>:$tile_elementwise,
    OptionalAttr<MOGG_KernelFunctionAttr>:$build_graph,
    OptionalAttr<MOGG_KernelFunctionAttr>:$execute_device,
    OptionalAttr<MOGG_KernelFunctionAttr>:$execute_configuration,
    OptionalAttr<MOGG_KernelReductionAttr>:$reduction,
    ArrayAttr:$struct_params,
    BoolAttr:$is_user_defined,
    UnitAttr:$supports_unfused_execute,
    OptionalAttr<StrAttr>:$sym_visibility
  );

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    custom<SymbolVisibility>($sym_visibility) `` $sym_name
    `registration` `=` $registration
    `device_info` `=` $registration_device_info
    (`execute` `=` $execute^)?
    (`elementwise` `=` $elementwise^)?
    (`tile_elementwise` `=` $tile_elementwise^)?
    (`build_graph` `=` $build_graph^)?
    (`execute_device` `=` $execute_device^)?
    (`execute_configuration` `=` $execute_configuration^)?
    (`reduction` `=` $reduction^)?
    `struct_params` `=` $struct_params
    `is_user_defined` `=` $is_user_defined
    (`supports_unfused_execute` $supports_unfused_execute^)?
    attr-dict
  }];
}

def MOGG_PrimitiveDeclOp
    : MOGG_Op<"primitive.decl", [SymbolName, SymbolVisibility, Symbol]> {
  let summary = "Declares a primitive Mojo function inline in the module";
  let description = [{
    Records the signature of a standalone `@register_internal` Mojo function
    (e.g. the `_foreach` driver). `sym_name` is its fully-qualified name and
    `registration` its intrinsic string (e.g. `"mogg.call.foreach"`). A
    primitive must have exactly one registration, since the symbol table
    rejects a duplicate `sym_name`. `result_params` is not populated.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    SymbolNameAttr:$sym_name,
    OptionalAttr<StrAttr>:$sym_visibility,
    StrAttr:$registration,
    MOGG_KernelFunctionAttr:$function
  );

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    custom<SymbolVisibility>($sym_visibility) `` $sym_name
    `registration` `=` $registration `function` `=` $function attr-dict
  }];
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// ShapeFunctionDeclOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def MOGG_ShapeFunctionDeclOp
    : MOGG_Op<"shape_func.decl", [SymbolName, SymbolVisibility, Symbol]> {
  let summary = "Declares the shape function for a kernel op registration";
  let description = [{
    At most one per registration (e.g. `"mo.avg_pool"`); import errors on
    duplicates. For a struct `shape` method, `sym_name` is
    `"<struct_sym>.shape"`. `result_params` is always populated, since shape
    functions return stdlib `IndexList`.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    SymbolNameAttr:$sym_name,
    OptionalAttr<StrAttr>:$sym_visibility,
    StrAttr:$registration,
    MOGG_KernelFunctionAttr:$function
  );

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    custom<SymbolVisibility>($sym_visibility) `` $sym_name
    `registration` `=` $registration `function` `=` $function attr-dict
  }];
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Advanced-fusion codegen ops
//
// `MAPToMOGG` lowers the `map` dialect into the ops below. Values are opaque
// handles; shape/dtype/mut/io live on the creating op.
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def MOGG_RoutineOp : MOGG_LowerableOp<"routine", [
  AttrSizedOperandSegments,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MemoryEffectsOpInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MO_ParamDeclaration>,
  MO_ExplicitDevice,
  MO_HasDeviceInterface,
  NoTerminator,
]> {
  let summary =
      "A codegen kernel: `!mo.tensor` inputs/outputs outside, `!mogg.pointer` "
      "inside.";
  let description = [{
    Lowered from `map.iter.opaque`. Inputs are `!mo.tensor` (or `!mo.buffer`
    for an in-place kernel `FuseMutableLoads` fused a buffer into) and outputs
    `!mo.tensor`. The entry-block arguments are one `!mogg.pointer` per input,
    one per output, then the dynamic `!mogg.dim`s, then a `!mogg.context`.
    There is no terminator: the output pointer arguments are the outputs.

    The optional `chain` sequences an in-place kernel and has no block
    argument; the output chain is the last of `outputs`. `device` gives the
    execution device so outlining need not fall back to the host. `fusionInfo`
    is absent only for hand-built kernels (e.g. in tests).
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    Variadic<AnyTypeOf<[MO_Tensor, MO_Buffer, MO_Opaque]>>:$inputs,
    Optional<MO_Chain>:$chain,
    OptionalAttr<MOGG_FusionInfoAttr>:$fusionInfo,
    MO_ParamDecls:$outputParamDecls,
    // Without these, a kernel whose only effect is a mutable store looks dead.
    DefaultValuedOptionalAttr<BoolAttr, "false">:$hasReadEffect,
    DefaultValuedOptionalAttr<BoolAttr, "false">:$hasWriteEffect,
    DefaultValuedOptionalAttr<MOGG_DispatchKindAttr,
                              "::M::MOGG::DispatchKind::Deferred">:$dispatch
  );
  let results = (outs Variadic<AnyTypeOf<[MO_Tensor, MO_Chain, MO_Opaque,
                                          MOGG_ShapeFuncResult]>>:$outputs);
  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$body);
  let hasVerifier = 1;
  let hasCustomAssemblyFormat = 1;

  let extraClassDeclaration = [{
    /// Returns the last entry of `outputs` if it is a chain, else null.
    ::mlir::Value getOutputChain();

    /// Lowers to a `mogg.routine.async` and registers its outputs;
    /// returns null on error. `mo.parallel` calls it per launch to collect
    /// regions it fuses into one async region.
    AsyncRoutineOp
    lowerToAsync(::M::MGP::MOGraphLoweringState &loweringState);
  }];
}

def MOGG_ShapeCreateOp : MOGG_Op<"shape.create", [
  Pure,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Build a codegen shape from a static shape attr + dynamic dims.";
  let description = [{
    `dynamic_dims` are in shape order, from the enclosing `mogg.routine` block
    arguments.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins Variadic<MOGG_Dim>:$dynamic_dims, MOSH_ShapeAttr:$shape);
  let results = (outs MOGG_Shape:$result);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $dynamic_dims `)` `<` `shape` `=` qualified($shape) `>`
    attr-dict (`:` qualified(type($dynamic_dims))^)?
  }];
}

def MOGG_TensorCreateOp : MOGG_Op<"tensor.create", [
  Pure,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MOGG_TensorCreateInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Build a codegen tensor from a pointer, shape and static metadata.";
  let description = [{
    Reconstructs a tensor inside a kernel body. `$device` (cpu vs gpu) lets
    emit pick the preferred alignment without consulting the kernel stub.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    MOGG_Pointer:$ptr,
    MOGG_Shape:$shape,
    MOSH_ShapeAttr:$shapeAttr,
    StrAttr:$device,
    TypeAttr:$elementType,
    BoolAttr:$mut,
    MO_IOKind:$io,
    // The source `!mo.tensor` was a stable address slot: emit builds a
    // `StableTensor` over the slot instead of a pointer-backed slice.
    DefaultValuedAttr<BoolAttr, "false">:$stable
  );
  // `!mo.buffer` reconstructs as `!mogg.buffer`, so `getKernelOperandKind()`
  // resolves `Buffer` vs `Tensor` from the type alone.
  let results = (outs AnyTypeOf<[MOGG_Tensor, MOGG_Buffer]>:$tensor);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $ptr `,` $shape `)`
    `<` `device` `=` $device `,` `elementType` `=` $elementType `,`
        `io` `=` custom<IOKind>($io) `,` `mut` `=` $mut `,`
        `shapeAttr` `=` qualified($shapeAttr)
        (`,` `stable` `=` $stable^)? `>`
    attr-dict `:` qualified(type($tensor))
  }];
}

def MOGG_TensorCreateEpilogueOp : MOGG_Op<"tensor.create.epilogue", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<OpAsmOpInterface, ["getAsmBlockArgumentNames"]>,
  AttrSizedOperandSegments,
  NoTerminator,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MOGG_FusedEpilogueInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "A fused-output tensor bound to its own epilogue body.";
  let description = [{
    A `!mogg.tensor` that writes through its own epilogue body, lowered from
    `map.iter.epilogue`. The body's entry-block arguments are the
    `!mogg.simd` value and its index, then the captures. `$device` (cpu vs
    gpu) lets emit pick the preferred alignment.

    A store body ends with `mogg.tensor.store` into the store-target capture.
    A compute body ends with `mogg.yield` of the value to store, leaving the
    store to the kernel; the store-target capture stays so emit has a slice to
    bind onto.

    `$computeOutputArg` records whether the kernel declares this output as a
    `_FusedComputeOutputTensor`, choosing `_bind_to_fused_compute_output` over
    `_bind_to_fused_output`. It is independent of the body shape: a
    dtype-changing epilogue or `enable-compute-lambdas=false` keeps a store
    body against a compute-capable argument.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    MOGG_Shape:$shape,
    Variadic<MOGG_TensorLike>:$captures,
    Variadic<MOGG_Shape>:$shapeCaptures,
    MOGG_Pointer:$outputPtr,
    StrAttr:$device,
    TypeAttr:$elementType,
    BoolAttr:$mut,
    MO_IOKind:$io,
    DefaultValuedAttr<BoolAttr, "false">:$computeOutputArg,
    // Present iff the kernel declares this output against a trait bound, so
    // emit wraps the functor in the trait tensor instead of a
    // `ManagedTensorSlice`. Set at MAP lowering, where the call edge is known.
    OptionalAttr<MOGG_TensorArgContractAttr>:$contract
  );
  let results = (outs MOGG_Tensor:$tensor);
  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$body);
  let hasCustomAssemblyFormat = 1;
  let hasVerifier = 1;
}

def MOGG_TileCreateEpilogueOp : MOGG_Op<"tile.create.epilogue", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<OpAsmOpInterface, ["getAsmBlockArgumentNames"]>,
  NoTerminator,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MOGG_FusedEpilogueInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "A tile fused-output tensor bound to its own epilogue body.";
  let description = [{
    The tile counterpart of `mogg.tensor.create.epilogue`: a `!mogg.tensor`
    whose epilogue runs once per tile the kernel produces, not once per
    element. The body's leading arguments are the kernel's tile and the tile
    index; one argument per capture follows, the first being the store
    target. A load in the body reads a whole tile of a capture at the index.

    `$lane` follows the kernel's declared output kind. A compute lane ends in
    `mogg.yield` of the transformed tile, which the kernel stores; a store
    lane ends in a store into the store-target capture and owns the write.
    Unlike the SIMD epilogue the two never decouple: a tile epilogue cannot
    change dtype or transform its index, so there is no fallback lane.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    %epi = mogg.tile.create.epilogue %shape (%val : !mogg.simd<f32>, %idx : !map.index<2>)
             capturing {%cout = %out : !mogg.tensor, %cz = %z : !mogg.tensor}
             ptr %ptr lane = compute, device = "gpu", elementType = f32,
             io = Output, mut = true {
      %zv = mogg.tensor.load %cz[%idx] : !mogg.tensor, !map.index<2> -> !mogg.simd<f32>
      %sum = mogg.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Add(%val, %zv)
               moOpName = "mo.add" : !mogg.simd<f32>, !mogg.simd<f32> -> !mogg.simd<f32>
      mogg.yield %sum : !mogg.simd<f32>
    }
    ```
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    MOGG_Shape:$shape,
    Variadic<MOGG_TensorLike>:$captures,
    MOGG_Pointer:$outputPtr,
    MOGG_TileFusionLaneAttr:$lane,
    StrAttr:$device,
    TypeAttr:$elementType,
    BoolAttr:$mut,
    MO_IOKind:$io
  );
  let results = (outs MOGG_Tensor:$tensor);
  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$body);
  let hasCustomAssemblyFormat = 1;
  let hasVerifier = 1;
}

def MOGG_TensorGetPtrOp : MOGG_Op<"tensor.get_ptr", [
  Pure,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Extract the raw `!mogg.pointer` backing a codegen tensor.";
  let description = [{
    Gives a `mogg.tensor.create.epilogue` the pointer of its store target (or
    of the pre-cast accumulation buffer for a mixed-precision accumulating
    kernel), so the fused output is built over real storage that an
    accumulating kernel can accumulate through.
  }];
  // A buffer when the epilogue stores into a fused `mo.mutable.store`.
  let arguments = (ins MOGG_TensorLike:$tensor);
  let results = (outs MOGG_Pointer:$ptr);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $tensor `)` attr-dict `:` qualified(type($tensor))
  }];
}

def MOGG_TensorCreatePrologueOp : MOGG_Op<"tensor.create.prologue", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<OpAsmOpInterface, ["getAsmBlockArgumentNames"]>,
  AttrSizedOperandSegments,
  SingleBlock,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "A fused-input tensor bound to its own prologue body.";
  let description = [{
    Load-side counterpart of `mogg.tensor.create.epilogue`, lowered from
    `map.iter.prologue`. The body takes the index followed by one rebuilt tile
    per capture and yields the value the kernel reads.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    MOGG_Shape:$shape,
    Variadic<MOGG_TensorLike>:$captures,
    // Runtime shapes for a dynamic `mogg.index.reshape` in the body; they
    // become trailing `IndexList` fields on the fusion functor.
    Variadic<MOGG_Shape>:$shapeCaptures,
    StrAttr:$device,
    TypeAttr:$elementType,
    BoolAttr:$mut,
    MO_IOKind:$io,
    // Present iff the kernel declares this input against a trait bound, so emit
    // wraps the functor in `_MoggInputLoadFusionTensor`.
    OptionalAttr<MOGG_TensorArgContractAttr>:$contract
  );
  let results = (outs MOGG_Tensor:$tensor);
  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$body);
  let hasCustomAssemblyFormat = 1;
  let hasVerifier = 1;
}

def MOGG_TensorStoreOp : MOGG_Op<"tensor.store", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Store a SIMD value into a codegen tensor at an index.";
  let arguments = (ins MOGG_TensorLike:$tensor, AnyType:$index, MOGG_Simd:$value);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $tensor `[` $index `]` `=` $value attr-dict `:`
    qualified(type($tensor)) `,` qualified(type($index)) `,` qualified(type($value))
  }];
}

def MOGG_CallOpaqueOp : MOGG_Op<"call.opaque", [
  MOGG_CallLike,
  AttrSizedOperandSegments,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
]> {
  let summary = "Call a registered opaque kernel's execute function.";
  let description = [{
    Invokes `$callee`'s `execute`. `$device_contexts` passes the device
    contexts explicitly: one for a single-device kernel, or one per device for
    a `DeviceContextArray`, which `ConformCallOperands` packs into a tuple.
    `$hasEpilogueFusion` spares emit from inspecting output producers.

    A kernel with `execute_device` is launched rather than called: emit calls
    its `execute_configuration`, then enqueues `execute_device` on the device
    context itself.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    FlatSymbolRefAttr:$callee,
    Variadic<AnyTypeOf<[MOGG_Tensor, MOGG_Buffer, MOGG_Scalar, MOGG_Tuple,
                        MO_Opaque]>>:$inputs,
    Variadic<AnyTypeOf<[MOGG_Tensor, MOGG_Buffer, MOGG_Scalar, MOGG_Tuple,
                        MO_Opaque]>>:$outputs,
    Variadic<AnyTypeOf<[MOGG_Context, MOGG_Tuple]>>:$device_contexts,
    OptionalAttr<DictionaryAttr>:$kernel_param,
    DefaultValuedAttr<BoolAttr, "false">:$hasEpilogueFusion,
    // The source op's `MO_SameVariadicOperandSize` trait, lost when it becomes
    // a call, so `ConformCallOperands` can split operands into equal-length
    // variadic groups (e.g. a collective's N inputs and N signal buffers).
    DefaultValuedAttr<BoolAttr, "false">:$hasSameVariadicOperandSize
  );
  // An `!mo.opaque` result is allocated inside the kernel body, so it has no
  // destination `$output`; `mogg.routine` forwards it with `mogg.output`.
  let results = (outs Optional<MO_Opaque>:$opaqueResult);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $callee `` custom<OptionalKernelParams>($kernel_param)
    (`inputs` `(` $inputs^ `:` type($inputs) `)`)?
    (`outputs` `(` $outputs^ `:` type($outputs) `)`)?
    (`context` `(` $device_contexts^ `:` type($device_contexts) `)`)?
    (`hasEpilogueFusion` `=` $hasEpilogueFusion^)?
    (`hasSameVariadicOperandSize` `=` $hasSameVariadicOperandSize^)?
    attr-dict (`->` type($opaqueResult)^)?
  }];
}

def MOGG_ScalarCreateOp : MOGG_Op<"scalar.create", [
  Pure,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Pack a single-element tensor operand into a scalar operand.";
  let description = [{
    Inserted by `ConformCallOperands` for an operand the kernel expects as a
    scalar.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins MOGG_Tensor:$tensor);
  let results = (outs MOGG_Scalar:$scalar);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $tensor `)` attr-dict
  }];
}

def MOGG_TraitCreateOp : MOGG_Op<"trait.create", [
  Pure,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Re-present a codegen tensor as its conforming trait argument.";
  let description = [{
    Inserted by `ConformCallOperands` for an operand the callee declares
    against a trait bound (`Tensor` / `TileTensorable`), which
    a `ManagedTensorSlice` does not satisfy. Emit wraps it in
    `_MoggDenseTensorArg` (execute) or `_MoggShapeTensorArg` (shape,
    `role = none`) per `$contract`. The result keeps the operand's
    tensor/buffer kind, so the call's emit is unchanged. Works over any
    producer, including non-row-major views. `$device` is as for
    `mogg.tensor.create`.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    MOGG_TensorLike:$tensor,
    StrAttr:$device,
    MOGG_TensorArgContractAttr:$contract
  );
  let results = (outs MOGG_TensorLike:$result);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $tensor `)` `contract` `=` $contract `,` `device` `=` $device
    attr-dict `:` functional-type(operands, results)
  }];
}

def MOGG_TupleCreateOp : MOGG_Op<"tuple.create", [
  Pure,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Pack a run of variadic tensor operands into a tuple operand.";
  let description = [{
    New-path counterpart of `mogg.as_tuple`: `ConformCallOperands`
    inserts this to pack the consecutive `!mogg.tensor` operands that satisfy a
    single variadic kernel argument into one `!mogg.tuple`. For a `TensorTuple`
    (`$variadic_abi = tensor_tuple`) the operands are the elements' trait
    arguments. It also packs the per-device `!mogg.context` operands of a
    distributed kernel into a tuple-of-contexts, which emit renders as a
    `DeviceContextArray`.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    Variadic<AnyTypeOf<[MOGG_Tensor, MOGG_Buffer, MOGG_Context]>>:$elements,
    DefaultValuedAttr<MOGG_VariadicABIAttr,
        "::M::MOGG::VariadicABI::Plain">:$variadic_abi);
  let results = (outs MOGG_Tuple:$tuple);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $elements `)` (`variadic_abi` `=` $variadic_abi^)?
    attr-dict (`:` qualified(type($elements))^)?
  }];
}

def MOGG_RebindOp : MOGG_Op<"rebind", [Pure,
    DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>]> {
  let summary = "A cast between an unpacked async handle and a codegen handle.";
  let description = [{
    E.g. `!mgp.buffer` -> `!mogg.pointer`, which emits Mojo extracting the raw
    data pointer from the `OwnedByteBuffer`; `!mogg.context` / `!mogg.dim`
    casts emit nothing.

    TODO: remove once `mogg.async.unpack` folds directly to the typed handle.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins AnyType:$input);
  let results = (outs AnyType:$output);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $input attr-dict `:` type($input) `to` type($output)
  }];
}

def MOGG_BufferConstantOp : MOGG_Op<"buffer.constant", [Pure]> {
  let summary = "A constant buffer, as a raw codegen pointer.";
  let description = [{
    A `mo.constant` that `FuseConstantIterOpaqueInputs` folded into a
    `map.iter.opaque` body, used like an input pointer. Carries no alignment,
    since the minimum CPU alignment is known only in `MOGGToMGP`, which
    rewrites it to `mgp.buffer.constant` plus a `mogg.rebind`.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins ElementsAttr:$value);
  let results = (outs MOGG_Pointer:$pointer);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $value attr-dict
  }];
}

def MOGG_TensorLoadOp : MOGG_Op<"tensor.load", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Load a SIMD value from a codegen tensor at an index.";
  let description = [{
    Not `Pure`, so it is not reordered across a store to the same tensor.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins MOGG_TensorLike:$tensor, AnyType:$index);
  let results = (outs MOGG_Simd:$result);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $tensor `[` $index `]` attr-dict `:`
    qualified(type($tensor)) `,` qualified(type($index)) `->` qualified(type($result))
  }];
}

def MOGG_TileLoadOp : MOGG_Op<"tile.load", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Load a tile of a codegen tensor at a tile coordinate.";
  let description = [{
    Reads the whole tile of `$tensor` at `$coord`, the tile counterpart of
    `mogg.tensor.load`. Emission stages each load into its own on-chip tile,
    so the op is not `Pure`: merging two loads would merge their staging
    tiles. Where `$tensor`'s element type is known from its creating op, it
    must match the result tile's.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    %t = mogg.tile.load %x[%coord] : !mogg.tensor, !mogg.tile_coord<2> -> !mogg.tile<f32>
    ```
  }];
  let arguments = (ins MOGG_TensorLike:$tensor, MOGG_TileCoord:$coord);
  let results = (outs MOGG_Tile:$result);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $tensor `[` $coord `]` attr-dict `:`
    qualified(type($tensor)) `,` qualified(type($coord)) `->` qualified(type($result))
  }];
  let hasVerifier = 1;
}

def MOGG_TileStoreOp : MOGG_Op<"tile.store", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Store a tile into a codegen tensor at a tile coordinate.";
  let description = [{
    Writes `$value` as the tile of `$tensor` at `$coord`, the tile counterpart
    of `mogg.tensor.store`. Where `$tensor`'s element type is known from its
    creating op, it must match the stored tile's.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    mogg.tile.store %out[%coord] = %t : !mogg.tensor, !mogg.tile_coord<2>, !mogg.tile<f32>
    ```
  }];
  let arguments = (ins MOGG_TensorLike:$tensor, MOGG_TileCoord:$coord,
                       MOGG_Tile:$value);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $tensor `[` $coord `]` `=` $value attr-dict `:`
    qualified(type($tensor)) `,` qualified(type($coord)) `,` qualified(type($value))
  }];
  let hasVerifier = 1;
}

def MOGG_ConstantScalarOp : MOGG_Op<"constant.scalar", [
  Pure,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "A scalar constant inlined into a fusion body as a literal.";
  let description = [{
    In a SIMD body the result is a `!mogg.simd`, as `mogg.tensor.load`
    produces, so it can replace a load; it is emitted as a literal splatted to
    the closure's SIMD width. The one builtin scalar result is the literal a
    tile call takes next to its tiles. Not `ConstantLike`, since that hoisting
    is wanted only on `map.constant.scalar`.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    %cst = mogg.constant.scalar 2.000000e+00 : f32 : !mogg.simd<f32>
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins TypedAttrInterface:$value);
  let results = (outs AnyTypeOf<[MOGG_Simd, AnyFloat, AnyInteger]>:$result);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $value attr-dict `:` qualified(type($result))
  }];
  let hasVerifier = 1;
}

def MOGG_CallForeachOp : MOGG_Op<"call.foreach", [
  MOGG_CallLike,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<OpAsmOpInterface, ["getAsmBlockArgumentNames"]>,
  NoTerminator,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
]> {
  let summary = "Drive a parallel foreach loop over a fused elementwise body.";
  let description = [{
    Runs the generic foreach driver `$callee` over `$shape`. The body does the
    per-index load-compute-store; its arguments are one per `$capturing`
    tensor, then the index. Lowered from a `map.iter.opaque` wrapping a
    `map.iter.elementwise.body`.

    Captures may differ in shape from `$shape` and each other (e.g.
    broadcasts), so there is no shape verifier. A capture is a `!mogg.buffer`
    where in-place fusion folded in a mutable buffer.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    FlatSymbolRefAttr:$callee,
    MOGG_Shape:$shape,
    MOGG_Context:$context,
    Variadic<MOGG_TensorLike>:$capturing,
    StrAttr:$device
  );
  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$body);
  let hasCustomAssemblyFormat = 1;
}

def MOGG_CallForeachTileOp : MOGG_Op<"call.foreach.tile", [
  MOGG_CallLike,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<OpAsmOpInterface, ["getAsmBlockArgumentNames"]>,
  NoTerminator,
]> {
  let summary = "Drive a tile foreach loop over a fused elementwise body.";
  let description = [{
    The tile counterpart of `mogg.call.foreach`: `$callee`, the tile foreach
    driver, runs the body once per tile of `$shape`. The body's arguments are
    one per `$capturing` tensor, then the tile index; it loads whole tiles of
    its input captures at the index, computes, and stores exactly once into
    its output capture.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    mogg.call.foreach.tile @builtin_primitives.primitives.foreach_fusion_tile
        shape(%s) context(%ctx) (%idx : !map.index<2>)
        capturing {%co = %out : !mogg.tensor, %cx = %x : !mogg.tensor}
        device = "gpu" {
      %xv = mogg.tensor.load %cx[%idx] : !mogg.tensor, !map.index<2> -> !mogg.simd<f32>
      mogg.tensor.store %co[%idx] = %xv : !mogg.tensor, !map.index<2>, !mogg.simd<f32>
    }
    ```
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    FlatSymbolRefAttr:$callee,
    MOGG_Shape:$shape,
    MOGG_Context:$context,
    Variadic<MOGG_TensorLike>:$capturing,
    StrAttr:$device
  );
  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$body);
  let hasCustomAssemblyFormat = 1;
  let hasVerifier = 1;
}

def MOGG_CallViewCopyOp : MOGG_Op<"call.view_copy", [
  MOGG_CallLike,
]> {
  let summary = "Copy a view into a tensor through the registered view-copy primitive.";
  let description = [{
    Materializes `$input`, a view (broadcast, transpose, slice, reshape) that
    the device cannot read in place, into `$output` by calling `$callee`, the
    `view_copy_impl` primitive. The primitive reads the view through the
    source slice's own strides, so it needs no loop body of its own, unlike
    the load/store body a `mogg.call.foreach` would run for the same copy.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    mogg.call.view_copy @builtin_primitives.primitives.view_copy_impl
        (%out, %bcast : !mogg.tensor, !mogg.tensor) context(%ctx) device = "gpu"
    ```
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    FlatSymbolRefAttr:$callee,
    MOGG_TensorLike:$output,
    MOGG_TensorLike:$input,
    MOGG_Context:$context,
    StrAttr:$device
  );
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $callee `(` $output `,` $input `:` type($output) `,` type($input) `)`
    `context` `(` $context `)` `device` `=` $device attr-dict
  }];
}

def MOGG_CallRowwiseOp : MOGG_Op<"call.rowwise", [
  MOGG_CallLike,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<OpAsmOpInterface, ["getAsmBlockArgumentNames"]>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
  NoTerminator,
]> {
  let summary = "Run a fused reduction body once per row.";
  let description = [{
    Runs its body once per row of `$shape` along `$axis`. The body holds the
    row's folds (`mogg.rowwise.reduce`), row-level ops and stores. Its
    arguments are one per `$capturing` tensor, then the row index, which has
    the `$axis` coordinate pinned to 0. Lowered from a `map.iter.opaque`
    wrapping a `map.iter.rowwise.body`.

    `mogg-legalize-rowwise-kernels` sets the rest, which the Row API needs:

    - `$primary`: the capture the folds walk along `$axis`.
    - `$dtype`: `$primary`'s element type.
    - `$accum`: the type the folds' contributions are computed in.
    - `$is_cached`: whether more than one fold reads the row.
    - `$cols`: the static size of `$axis`.
    - `$num_phases`: 1 when the body is reduce-shaped.
    - `$dtype_size`: `$primary`'s byte size when the body may split the
      row, else 0.
    - `$computationally_expensive`: whether the folds' per-element work
      reaches the pass's cost threshold.
    - `$simd_monoid`: the fold monoid that picks the SIMD width, the one
      with the largest state.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    mogg.call.rowwise shape(%shape) axis(1) context(%ctx) (%row : !map.index<2>)
        capturing {%x = %X : !mogg.tensor, %out = %OUT : !mogg.tensor}
        device = "cpu" {
      %acc = mogg.rowwise.reduce @builtin_kernels.monoids.ReduceSum
          (%i : !map.index<2>) -> !mogg.simd<f32> {
        %v = mogg.tensor.load %x[%i] : !mogg.tensor, !map.index<2> -> !mogg.simd<f32>
        mogg.yield %v : !mogg.simd<f32>
      }
      mogg.tensor.store %out[%row] = %acc : !mogg.tensor, !map.index<2>, !mogg.simd<f32>
    }
    ```
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    MOGG_Shape:$shape,
    I64Attr:$axis,
    MOGG_Context:$context,
    Variadic<MOGG_TensorLike>:$capturing,
    StrAttr:$device,
    OptionalAttr<I64Attr>:$primary,
    OptionalAttr<TypeAttr>:$dtype,
    OptionalAttr<TypeAttr>:$accum,
    UnitAttr:$is_cached,
    OptionalAttr<I64Attr>:$cols,
    OptionalAttr<I64Attr>:$num_phases,
    OptionalAttr<I64Attr>:$dtype_size,
    UnitAttr:$computationally_expensive,
    OptionalAttr<FlatSymbolRefAttr>:$simd_monoid
  );
  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$body);
  let hasCustomAssemblyFormat = 1;
}

def MOGG_RowwisePrimaryOp : MOGG_Op<"rowwise.primary", [
  HasParent<"MOGG::RowwiseReduceOp">,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "The primary input's value at the current element.";
  let description = [{
    Stands for a load of the `primary` capture at the fold's own index. The
    row is loaded once and handed to each fold.
  }];
  let results = (outs MOGG_Simd:$result);
  let assemblyFormat = "attr-dict `:` qualified(type($result))";
}

def MOGG_RowwiseEmitOp : MOGG_Op<"rowwise.emit", [
  HasParent<"MOGG::CallRowwiseOp">,
  NoTerminator,
  SingleBlock,
]> {
  let summary = "The per-row stores of a rowwise kernel.";
  let description = [{
    Holds the stores at the row index. Only one participant of a row writes.
  }];
  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$body);
  let assemblyFormat = "attr-dict-with-keyword $body";
}

def MOGG_RowwiseReduceOp : MOGG_Op<"rowwise.reduce", [
  HasParent<"MOGG::CallRowwiseOp">,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<OpAsmOpInterface, ["getAsmBlockArgumentNames"]>,
  SingleBlock,
]> {
  let summary = "Fold the current row with a monoid.";
  let description = [{
    Folds every element of the enclosing row with `$monoid`. The body runs
    once per element, at the index in its argument, and yields the
    element's contribution. The results are the monoid's output fields.

    `$params` binds the monoid's dtype parameters and `$fields` names the
    output field behind each result.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    FlatSymbolRefAttr:$monoid,
    OptionalAttr<DictionaryAttr>:$params,
    OptionalAttr<StrArrayAttr>:$fields
  );
  let results = (outs Variadic<MOGG_Simd>:$results);
  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$body);
  let hasCustomAssemblyFormat = 1;
  let hasVerifier = 1;
}

def MOGG_CallShapeOp : MOGG_Op<"call.shape", [
  MOGG_CallLike,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<SymbolUserOpInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Call a registered shape function, returning its shape by value.";
  let description = [{
    `$kernel_param` carries `output_rank`, the rank of `$result`.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    FlatSymbolRefAttr:$callee,
    UnitAttr:$isThrows,
    Variadic<AnyTypeOf<[MOGG_Tensor, MOGG_Scalar, MOGG_Tuple]>>:$operands,
    OptionalAttr<DictionaryAttr>:$kernel_param
  );
  let results = (outs MOGG_ShapeFuncResult:$result);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $callee `` custom<OptionalKernelParams>($kernel_param) ``
    `(` $operands `:` type($operands) `)` `->` type($result)
    (`isThrows` $isThrows^)? attr-dict
  }];
}

def MOGG_CallElementwiseOp : MOGG_Op<"call.elementwise", [
  MOGG_CallLike,
  AttrSizedOperandSegments,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MOGG_KernelCallInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<SymbolUserOpInterface>,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Call the registered `::elementwise` function for a particular kernel";
  let description = [{
    Calls the `::elementwise` function of the kernel named by `$callee`,
    taking the iteration index as an explicit operand.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    mogg.call.elementwise @"mo.add"(...)
    ```
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    FlatSymbolRefAttr:$callee,
    StrAttr:$moOpName,
    Variadic<AnyType>:$inputs,
    Optional<AnyType>:$index,
    OptionalAttr<DictionaryAttr>:$kernel_param
  );
  let results = (outs Variadic<AnyType>:$outputs);
  let hasVerifier = 1;

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $callee `` custom<OptionalKernelParams>($kernel_param) ``
    `(` $inputs (`,` $index^)? `)` `moOpName` `=` $moOpName
    attr-dict `:` type($inputs) (`,` type($index)^)? `->` type($outputs)
  }];

  // `KernelCallInterface::getKernelSymNameAttr` must hand back the leaf
  // `StringAttr` (the same interned attr the kernel decl's `sym_name` carries,
  // so symbol-liveness set membership still works); the callee is stored as a
  // `FlatSymbolRefAttr` here rather than a bare string the way `call.opaque`
  // does.
  let extraClassDeclaration = [{
    mlir::StringAttr getKernelSymNameAttr() {
      return getCalleeAttr().getLeafReference();
    }
  }];
}

def MOGG_TensorCreateSliceOp : MOGG_Op<"tensor.create.slice", [
  Pure,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MOGG_TensorCreateInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Build a codegen tensor that is a strided slice view of another codegen tensor.";
  let description = [{
    A zero-copy view indexed by the consuming loop's index.
    `$outShape`/`$staticStart`/`$staticStep` hold the static parts (`?` for
    runtime-only dimensions).
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    MOSH_ShapeAttr:$outShape,
    DenseI64ArrayAttr:$staticStart,
    DenseI64ArrayAttr:$staticStep,
    TypeAttr:$elementType,
    BoolAttr:$mut,
    MOGG_TensorLike:$input,
    MOGG_Tensor:$starts,
    MOGG_Tensor:$stops,
    MOGG_Tensor:$steps
  );
  let results = (outs MOGG_Tensor:$result);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $input `,` $starts `,` $stops `,` $steps `)`
    `<` `elementType` `=` $elementType `,` `mut` `=` $mut `,`
        `outShape` `=` qualified($outShape) `,`
        `staticStart` `=` qualified($staticStart) `,`
        `staticStep` `=` qualified($staticStep) `>`
    attr-dict `:` qualified(type($input))
  }];
}

def MOGG_TensorCreateBroadcastOp : MOGG_Op<"tensor.create.broadcast", [
  Pure,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MOGG_TensorCreateInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Build a codegen tensor that is a broadcast view of another codegen tensor.";
  let description = [{
    A zero-copy view with numpy broadcasting semantics, indexed by the
    consuming loop's index.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    MOSH_ShapeAttr:$outShape,
    TypeAttr:$elementType,
    BoolAttr:$mut,
    MOGG_TensorLike:$input
  );
  let results = (outs MOGG_Tensor:$result);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $input `)`
    `<` `elementType` `=` $elementType `,` `mut` `=` $mut `,`
        `outShape` `=` qualified($outShape) `>`
    attr-dict `:` qualified(type($input))
  }];
}

def MOGG_TensorCreateTransposeOp : MOGG_Op<"tensor.create.transpose", [
  Pure,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MOGG_TensorCreateInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Build a codegen tensor that is a transpose view of another codegen tensor.";
  let description = [{
    A zero-copy view indexed by the consuming loop's index.
    `$staticPermutations[i]` is the `$input` dimension that becomes output
    dimension `i` (`?` if known only at runtime, then read from
    `$permutations`).
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    MOSH_ShapeAttr:$outShape,
    DenseI64ArrayAttr:$staticPermutations,
    TypeAttr:$elementType,
    BoolAttr:$mut,
    MOGG_TensorLike:$input,
    MOGG_Tensor:$permutations
  );
  let results = (outs MOGG_Tensor:$result);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $input `,` $permutations `)`
    `<` `elementType` `=` $elementType `,` `mut` `=` $mut `,`
        `outShape` `=` qualified($outShape) `,`
        `staticPermutations` `=` qualified($staticPermutations) `>`
    attr-dict `:` qualified(type($input))
  }];
}

def MOGG_TensorCreateReshapeOp : MOGG_Op<"tensor.create.reshape", [
  Pure,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MOGG_TensorCreateInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Build a codegen tensor that is a reshape view of another codegen tensor.";
  let description = [{
    A zero-copy row-major view indexed by the consuming loop's index.
    `$outShape` is the static shape (`dyn` where unknown) and `$shape` the
    runtime one, built with `mogg.shape.create` so identical shapes CSE.
    Unlike broadcast/transpose, the result's stride comes from the output
    shape alone, so a wrong runtime dim corrupts every element past the first
    row.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    MOSH_ShapeAttr:$outShape,
    TypeAttr:$elementType,
    BoolAttr:$mut,
    MOGG_TensorLike:$input,
    MOGG_Shape:$shape
  );
  let results = (outs MOGG_Tensor:$result);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $input `,` $shape `)`
    `<` `elementType` `=` $elementType `,` `mut` `=` $mut `,`
        `outShape` `=` qualified($outShape) `>`
    attr-dict `:` qualified(type($input))
  }];
}

def MOGG_IndexReshapeOp : MOGG_Op<"index.reshape", [
  Pure,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Reindex an N-D index into an M-D index preserving row-major offset.";
  let description = [{
    The per-index counterpart of `mogg.tensor.create.reshape`, for a reshape
    fused into an epilogue's store. Not hoisted, since it depends on the loop
    index. `$dynamicShapes` supplies runtime shapes for any dynamic dims and
    is empty when both shapes are static.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    %j = mogg.index.reshape(%i) <fromShape = #mosh<ape[8, 8]> : !mosh.ape, toShape = #mosh<ape[64]> : !mosh.ape> : (!map.index<2>) -> !map.index<1>
    ```
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    AnyType:$index,
    MOSH_ShapeAttr:$fromShape,
    MOSH_ShapeAttr:$toShape,
    Variadic<MOGG_Shape>:$dynamicShapes
  );
  let results = (outs AnyType:$result);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $index (`,` $dynamicShapes^)? `)`
    `<` `fromShape` `=` qualified($fromShape) `,`
        `toShape` `=` qualified($toShape) `>`
    attr-dict `:` qualified(type($index)) `->` qualified(type($result))
  }];
}

def MOGG_IndexSliceSelectOp : MOGG_Op<"index.slice.select", [
  SingleBlock,
  NoTerminator,
  RecursiveMemoryEffects,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Run a body at a slice's output index, where the slice selects an index.";
  let description = [{
    Lowering of `map.index.slice.select`, in place inside an epilogue functor
    body like a store-side `mogg.index.reshape`: the body runs only where the
    slice selects `$index`, with its one block argument bound to the matching
    index in the slice's output. `$inShape`/`$outShape` are the slice's static
    shapes (`dyn` where unknown) and `$staticStart`/`$staticStep` its bounds.
    `$dynamicShapes` is the runtime [in-shape, out-shape] pair when either
    shape has a dynamic dim, and empty otherwise.

    Evaluated once per stored vector at the vector's first index, so the
    innermost dim, which the vector runs along, must be unsliced.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    mogg.index.slice.select(%i) <inShape = #mosh<ape[2, 9, 16]> : !mosh.ape, outShape = #mosh<ape[2, 8, 16]> : !mosh.ape, staticStart = array<i64: 0, 1, 0>, staticStep = array<i64: 1, 1, 1>> : !map.index<3> {
    ^bb0(%j: !map.index<3>):
      mogg.tensor.store %window[%j] = %val : !mogg.tensor, !map.index<3>, !mogg.simd<f32>
    }
    ```
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    AnyType:$index,
    MOSH_ShapeAttr:$inShape,
    MOSH_ShapeAttr:$outShape,
    DenseI64ArrayAttr:$staticStart,
    DenseI64ArrayAttr:$staticStep,
    Variadic<MOGG_Shape>:$dynamicShapes
  );
  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$body);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $index (`,` $dynamicShapes^)? `)`
    `<` `inShape` `=` qualified($inShape) `,`
        `outShape` `=` qualified($outShape) `,`
        `staticStart` `=` qualified($staticStart) `,`
        `staticStep` `=` qualified($staticStep) `>`
    attr-dict `:` qualified(type($index))
    $body
  }];
}

#define GENERICML_GRAPHCOMPILER_MOGGDIALECT_MOGGPASSES_TD

include "mlir/Pass/PassBase.td"

def JitCompileKernels: Pass<"jit", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Replace kernel op with calls into compiled kernel";
  let description = [{
    Compiles kernel ops with the KGEN pipeline into resource blobs and replaces
    them with calls into the compiled code, inserting an op that maps kernel
    names to blobs.
  }];
  let dependentDialects = [
    "M::MDialect",
    "M::MOGG::MOGGDialect",
    "M::KGEN::KGENDialect",
    "M::KGEN::LIT::LITDialect",
    "M::KGEN::POP::POPDialect",
    "M::HLCF::HLCFDialect",
    "M::DebugInfo::DebugInfoDialect",
    "mlir::LLVM::LLVMDialect",
    "mlir::NVVM::NVVMDialect",
    "mlir::ROCDL::ROCDLDialect",
    "mlir::index::IndexDialect",
  ];

  let options = [
    Option<"saveTempPrefix", "save-temp-prefix", "std::string", /*default=*/"",
            "The prefix to use when saving temporary files. Setting this "
            "option toggles on saveTemps.">,
    Option<"dumpStub", "dump-stub", "bool", /*default=*/"false",
            "Prints the generated KGEN stub for use in tests and debugging">,
    Option<"createMOGGReproducers", "create-mogg-reproducers", "bool", /*default=*/"false",
            "Creates isolated reproducers of each kernel in a new mo graph.">,
    ListOption<"kernelLibraryPaths", "kernel-library-paths", "std::string",
      "Paths to mojo packages containing mojo kernel definitions to be loaded.">,
    Option<"minimumCpuAlignment", "min-cpu-alignment", "size_t",
      /*default=*/"kPreferredMemoryAlignment",
     "Minimum alignment for all CPU buffers (both constants and allocated)">,
    Option<"timeMOGGCompile", "time-mogg-compile", "bool",
      /*default=*/"false",
     "Turns on timing for the KGEN passes invoked by mogg">,
    Option<"dryRun", "dry-run", "bool",
      /*default=*/"false",
     "Run the pass but don't actually compile.">,
    Option<"debugKGENStubs", "debug-kgen-stubs", "bool",
      /*default=*/"false",
      "Create debuginfo for kgen stubs such that the debugger will give linenumbers for the stubs">,
    Option<"defaultDeviceTargetArch", "default-device-target-arch", "std::string",
      /*default=*/"",
      "Together with default-device-target-triple, overrides the accelerator "
      "arch (e.g. sm_100a) instead of probing the host GPU. Enables "
      "cross-compilation for a target GPU on a machine that lacks it (or has no "
      "GPU at all).">,
    Option<"defaultDeviceTargetTriple", "default-device-target-triple", "std::string",
      /*default=*/"",
      "Target triple (e.g. nvptx64-nvidia-cuda) identifying the accelerator "
      "vendor for default-device-target-arch. The override applies only when "
      "this triple names a GPU target.">,
    Option<"compileForHostExecution", "compile-for-host-execution", "bool",
      /*default=*/"false",
      "Compile kernels for this machine, ignoring any virtual CPU target "
      "override. For artifacts that execute in the compiling process "
      "(constant folding).">
  ];
}

def PatternFusion: Pass<"mo-pattern-fusion", "MO::GraphOp"> {
  let summary = "Fuse kernels based on patterns.";
  let description = [{
    Replaces op sequences with a call to a hand-fused kernel, or with more
    specific ops (e.g. concat with axis 0).
  }];
  let dependentDialects = ["M::MOGG::MOGGDialect"];
  let options = [
    Option<"enableMHAPattern", "mha-enable", "bool", /*default=*/"true",
            "Enable multi-head attention pattern.">,
    Option<"debugMHAPattern", "mha-debug", "bool", /*default=*/"false",
            "Enable multi-head attention pattern matching logs. Useful for debugging pattern matching failures.">,
    Option<"mhaAllowUnsafeBCast", "mha-allow-unsafe-bcast", "bool", /*default=*/"true",
            "Allow potentially unsafe broadcasts to be pattern matched for MHA patterns.">,
    Option<"mhaAllowInternalReshape", "mha-allow-internal-reshape", "bool", /*default=*/"true",
            "Allow potentially unsafe broadcasts to be pattern matched for MHA patterns.">,
    Option<"enableMegaFFNPattern", "mega-ffn-enable", "bool", /*default=*/"true",
            "Enable the NVFP4 MegaFFN fusion (grouped_matmul_swiglu_nvfp4 + "
            "grouped_matmul_block_scaled -> mega_ffn_nvfp4). Only fires on SM100 "
            "targets; the kernel is MAX-only, so this is disabled in OSS builds.">,
    Option<"targetDevice", "target-device",  "std::string", "\"\"",
           "If the graph operation does not already have a device specified, "
           "use this device for pattern fusion passes that depend on the target device.">,
    Option<"targetDeviceId", "target-device-id",  "size_t", "0",
           "If target-device is provided, this is the default-id to target">
  ];
}

def HashModuleContents: Pass<"mogg-hash-module-contents", "mlir::ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Compute and attach hash of module contents";
  let description = [{
    Attaches a hash of the module contents as an attribute, for caching.
  }];
  let dependentDialects = [
    "M::MOGG::MOGGDialect",
    "M::KGEN::KGENDialect",
  ];
}

def NormalizeAllNames: Pass<"mogg-normalize-all-names", "mlir::ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Normalize all names in the module";
  let description = [{
    Renames symbols to __S0, __S1, ... and parameters to __P0, __P1, ... so
    caching and hashing ignore naming variations.
  }];
  let dependentDialects = [
    "M::MOGG::MOGGDialect",
    "M::KGEN::KGENDialect",
  ];
}

def LowerCompiledRoutines: Pass<"mogg-lower-compiled-routines", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Convert MOGG compile ops into MGP versions";
  let description = [{
    Converts raw MOGG compiled kernels into the MGP format used by other
    compiled code.
  }];

  let dependentDialects = ["MEF::MEFDialect",
                          "MGP::MGPDialect",
                          "GRT::GRTDialect",
                          "MOGG::MOGGDialect"];
}

def SequenceFusion: Pass<"mogg-sequence-fusion", "MGP::ModelOp"> {
  let summary = "Fuse sequences of AsyncRoutineOp";
  let description = [{}];

  let options = [
    Option<"enableTransitiveFusion", "enable-transitive-fusion", "bool", "false",
      "Flag to allow control of fusion pass">
  ];
  let dependentDialects = ["MEF::MEFDialect",
                          "MGP::MGPDialect",
                          "GRT::GRTDialect",
                          "MOGG::MOGGDialect"];
}

def AddProfileScopeTracing: Pass<"mogg-add-profile-scope-tracing", "MOGG::FuncOp"> {
  let summary = "Bracket Graph profile scope ranges inside kernel stub bodies";
  let description = [{
    Synthesizes profiler trace ranges (`mogg.profile_scope.begin` /
    `mogg.profile_scope.end`) from contiguous runs of ops that share the same
    `Graph.profile_scope(...)` layer set, plus coarser ancestor ranges over
    adjacent runs nested under a common outer scope.

    Only MGP-ABI stubs are bracketed. Runs before `mogg-add-try-except-blocks`
    because begin/end can raise and must land inside its try/except.
  }];

  let options = [
    Option<"profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled", "profile-scope-tracing-trace-unlabelled", "bool", /*default=*/"false",
      "Emit ranges for regions carrying no profile scope. Useful for visualizing compiler output.">
  ];

  let dependentDialects = ["MGP::MGPDialect", "MOGG::MOGGDialect"];
}

def WrapFuncsWithTrace: Pass<"mogg-wrap-funcs-with-trace", "MOGG::FuncOp"> {
  let summary = "Wraps a MOGG ABI kernel stub's body in a trace range";
  let description = [{
    `mogg.with_trace` emits the per-kernel `Trace` range. MGP-ABI stubs get
    theirs from `mogg-add-profile-scope-tracing`. Runs before
    `mogg-add-try-except-blocks`, which moves this op into its try.
  }];

  let dependentDialects = ["MOGG::MOGGDialect"];
}

def AddTryExceptBlocks: Pass<"mogg-add-try-except-blocks", "MOGG::FuncOp"> {
  let summary = "Adds a try-except block to raising kernels";
  let description = [{
    Runs after sequence fusion and before Mojo codegen, so emitted Mojo for
    raising kernels handles errors.
  }];

  let dependentDialects = ["MGP::MGPDialect", "MOGG::MOGGDialect"];
}

def OutlineAsyncRoutines: Pass<"mogg-outline-async-routines", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Outline kernels into stubs";
  let description = [{
    Outlines AsyncRoutineOp into FuncOp so identical stubs can
    be merged. Runs after all optimization passes, just before Mojo codegen.
  }];

  let dependentDialects = ["MGP::MGPDialect", "MOGG::MOGGDialect"];
}

def OutlineRoutines
    : Pass<"mogg-outline-routines", "mlir::ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Outline each `mogg.routine` body into a `mogg.func`.";
  let description = [{
    Moves each `mogg.routine` body into a module-level `mogg.func` with
    the `MAP` ABI (so `EmitMojo` can branch on it), leaving a single
    `mogg.call` that forwards the block arguments. The `mogg.routine` is
    kept for its `!mo.tensor` interface, which `MOGGToMGP` lowers.
  }];

  let dependentDialects = [
    "M::MO::MODialect",
    "M::MOGG::MOGGDialect",
  ];
}

def LegalizeRowwiseKernels
    : Pass<"mogg-legalize-rowwise-kernels", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Fill in what each rowwise kernel needs to print as Mojo.";
  let description = [{
    Runs `mogg-rowwise-select-primary-input`, `mogg-rowwise-bind-monoids`,
    `mogg-rowwise-group-row-stores` and `mogg-rowwise-set-launch-params`, in
    that order, on every `mogg.call.rowwise`.
  }];

  let options = [
    Option<"expensiveCostThreshold", "expensive-cost-threshold", "unsigned",
           /*default=*/"16",
           "Per-element cost at which a kernel is computationally expensive. "
           "An op that divides or calls a transcendental costs 16, any other "
           "op 1.">,
  ];

  let dependentDialects = ["MOGG::MOGGDialect", "M::MO::MODialect"];
}

def RowwiseSelectPrimaryInput
    : Pass<"mogg-rowwise-select-primary-input", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Pick the input each rowwise kernel reads element by element. "
                "For testing only.";
  let description = [{
    Sets `primary` on each `mogg.call.rowwise` to the capture its first fold
    loads at the element index, and turns those loads, in every fold, into
    `mogg.rowwise.primary`. Also sets `dtype` (the primary input's element
    type) and `is_cached` (whether more than one fold reads it).
  }];

  let dependentDialects = ["MOGG::MOGGDialect"];
}

def RowwiseBindMonoids: Pass<"mogg-rowwise-bind-monoids", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Bind each fold's monoid. For testing only.";
  let description = [{
    Sets each fold's `params` (dtype parameters bound from its result types)
    and `fields` (its monoid's output field names), checks fixed field
    dtypes, and sets `accum`, the widest contribution type, on the kernel.
  }];

  let dependentDialects = ["MOGG::MOGGDialect"];
}

def RowwiseGroupRowStores: Pass<"mogg-rowwise-group-row-stores", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Move per-row stores into one emit. For testing only.";
  let description = [{
    Moves the stores at the row index of each `mogg.call.rowwise` into one
    `mogg.rowwise.emit` at the end of its body.
  }];

  let dependentDialects = ["MOGG::MOGGDialect"];
}

def RowwiseSetLaunchParams
    : Pass<"mogg-rowwise-set-launch-params", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Set each rowwise kernel's launch parameters. For testing "
                "only.";
  let description = [{
    Sets the launch parameters of each `mogg.call.rowwise`, and `cols` when
    the reduced axis is static. Runs after `mogg-rowwise-group-row-stores`: a
    body is reduce-shaped when all its stores are in the emit. Only
    reduce-shaped bodies are supported.
  }];

  let options = [
    Option<"expensiveCostThreshold", "expensive-cost-threshold", "unsigned",
           /*default=*/"16",
           "Per-element cost at which a kernel is computationally expensive. "
           "An op that divides or calls a transcendental costs 16, any other "
           "op 1.">,
  ];

  let dependentDialects = ["MOGG::MOGGDialect", "M::MO::MODialect"];
}

def AnonymizeDimNames: Pass<"mogg-anonymize-dim-names", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Drop symbolic dim names from every kernel stub's signature.";
  let description = [{
    Turns every `!mogg.dim<name>` in a `mogg.func` signature into
    `!mogg.dim`, so `MergeIdenticalFuncs` can merge stubs that differ
    only in dim names. Runs inside `EmitMojo` just before that merge.
  }];

  let dependentDialects = ["MOGG::MOGGDialect"];
}


def MergeIdenticalFuncs: Pass<"mogg-merge-identical-funcs", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Merge kernel stubs that are identical";
  let description = [{
    CSE for MOGG::FuncOp, reducing IR size and emitted Mojo.
  }];

  let dependentDialects = ["MGP::MGPDialect", "MOGG::MOGGDialect"];

  let statistics = [
    Statistic<"numMergedStubs", "# of stubs that were merged", "Number of stubs that were merged">
  ];
}

def CanonicalizeFuncsForMerge:
    Pass<"mogg-canonicalize-funcs-for-merge", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Erase what emission ignores inside kernel stubs so copies merge";
  let description = [{
    Inside each `mogg.func` body, rewrites what emission does not read, so
    copies of a kernel that differ only there merge in `MergeIdenticalFuncs`:

    - every `#M.device_ref<label, id>` (attributes and `!mgp.tensor` types) to
      id 0, since emission reads only the label (e.g. an EP-sharded MoE's
      per-device copies). See GEX-4239.
    - every dynamic dim of a `#mosh.ape` op attribute to `dyn`, since emission
      reads only the rank and static dims; runtime dims come from operands
      (e.g. per-layer copies that differ only in a symbolic dim name).

    Call sites keep real ids and names.
  }];

  let dependentDialects = ["MGP::MGPDialect", "MOGG::MOGGDialect"];
}

def LiftBufferCacheSlots: Pass<"mogg-lift-buffer-cache-slots", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Lift inline `index.constant` slot operands of mgp.buffer.get_cached to kernel args";
  let description = [{
    In each MGP-ABI `mogg.func`, promotes `index.constant` ops used
    only as `mgp.buffer.get_cached` slots to trailing kernel arguments,
    materialized at each `mogg.compiled.call` call site. Kernels differing
    only in slot indices can then merge. See GEX-3685.
  }];

  let dependentDialects = ["MGP::MGPDialect", "MOGG::MOGGDialect", "mlir::index::IndexDialect"];
}

def LookupConstantResources: Pass<"mogg-lookup-constant-resources", "MOGG::FuncOp"> {
  let summary = "Replace mgp.buffer.constant with mgp.resource.constant";
  let description = [{
    Reads constants from resources attached to the parent `mogg.func`,
    so kernels differing only in constant values still merge.
  }];

  let dependentDialects = ["MGP::MGPDialect"];
}

def EmitMojo: Pass<"mogg-emit-mojo", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Emit Mojo text";
  let description = [{
    Emits Mojo from kernel stubs and `mogg.routine.async`, held
    until JIT compilation.
  }];

  let options = [
    ListOption<"kernelLibraryPaths", "kernel-library-paths", "std::string",
      "Paths to mojo packages containing mojo kernel definitions to be loaded.">,
    Option<"enableOpTraceComments", "enable-op-trace-comments", "bool", "false", "Flag to enable adding comments in the Mojo code detailing which operation is being emitted.">,
    Option<"enableComputeLambdas", "enable-compute-lambdas", "bool", "true",
      "Enable compute lambdas for the fused I/O kernels">,
    Option<"moggDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs", "mogg-debug-dump-fused-tensor-specs", "bool", "false",
      "Flag to add prints for the fused tensor specs in the lambdas">
  ];

  let dependentDialects = ["MEF::MEFDialect",
                          "MGP::MGPDialect",
                          "GRT::GRTDialect",
                          "MOGG::MOGGDialect",
                          "M::KGEN::KGENDialect",
                          "M::KGEN::LIT::LITDialect",
                          "M::KGEN::POP::POPDialect",
                          "M::HLCF::HLCFDialect",
                          "M::DebugInfo::DebugInfoDialect",
                          "mlir::NVVM::NVVMDialect",
                          "mlir::ROCDL::ROCDLDialect",
                          "mlir::index::IndexDialect",
  ];
}

def DumpMojo: Pass<"mogg-dump-mojo", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Dump Mojo text";
  let description = [{
    Dumps the emitted Mojo to stderr.
  }];

  let dependentDialects = ["MEF::MEFDialect",
                          "MGP::MGPDialect",
                          "GRT::GRTDialect",
                          "MOGG::MOGGDialect",
                          "M::KGEN::KGENDialect",
                          "M::KGEN::LIT::LITDialect",
                          "M::KGEN::POP::POPDialect",
                          "M::HLCF::HLCFDialect",
                          "M::DebugInfo::DebugInfoDialect",
                          "mlir::NVVM::NVVMDialect",
                          "mlir::ROCDL::ROCDLDialect",
                          "mlir::index::IndexDialect",
    ];
}

def LoadMojo: Pass<"mogg-load-mojo", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Load Mojo text";
  let description = [{
    Replaces the module's Mojo with the given file, for editing dumped Mojo
    before running -jit-pipeline.

    Example:
    mo-opt program.mlir -gc-pipeline -o /dev/null -mlir-print-ir-after=mogg-emit-mojo &> program.mgp.mlir
    mo-opt program.mgp.mlir -mogg-dump-mojo -o /dev/null &> program.mojo
    # Modify Mojo here
    mo-opt program.mgp.mlir -mogg-load-mojo=path=program.mojo -jit-pipeline
  }];

  let options = [
    Option<"path", "path", "std::string", "\"\"",
      "The label for resulting MGP graph. Default is mof.">
  ];

  let dependentDialects = ["MEF::MEFDialect",
                          "MGP::MGPDialect",
                          "GRT::GRTDialect",
                          "MOGG::MOGGDialect",
                          "M::KGEN::KGENDialect",
                          "M::KGEN::LIT::LITDialect",
                          "M::KGEN::POP::POPDialect",
                          "M::HLCF::HLCFDialect",
                          "M::DebugInfo::DebugInfoDialect",
                          "mlir::NVVM::NVVMDialect",
                          "mlir::ROCDL::ROCDLDialect",
                          "mlir::index::IndexDialect",
  ];
}

def ImportPackages : Pass<"mogg-import-packages", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Import Mojo kernel packages and emit mogg.kernel.decl ops";
  let description = [{
    Emits one mogg.kernel.decl per registered kernel, recording its signatures,
    so later passes read them from the IR instead of loading packages. Runs
    early in the pipeline.

    - mojo-pkg-paths: compiled .mojoc files.
    - lit-mlir-paths: kgen-translate -import-mojo output; skips built-in
      packages, for self-contained lit tests.
  }];
  let options = [
    ListOption<"mojoPkgPaths", "mojo-pkg-paths", "std::string",
      "Paths to compiled .mojoc files containing kernel definitions.">,
    ListOption<"litMlirPaths", "lit-mlir-paths", "std::string",
      "Paths to MLIR files (kgen-translate -import-mojo output) for testing. "
      "Built-in packages are not loaded when this option is used alone.">,
    Option<"append", "append", "bool", /*default=*/"false",
      "Append mode: seed the registration/primitive deduplication sets from "
      "decl ops already present in the module, and skip loading built-in "
      "packages. Callers pass only the delta paths not yet loaded; existing "
      "decls in the module are preserved.">,
  ];
  let dependentDialects = [
    "M::MOGG::MOGGDialect",
    "M::KGEN::KGENDialect",
    "M::KGEN::LIT::LITDialect",
    "M::KGEN::POP::POPDialect",
    "M::HLCF::HLCFDialect",
    "M::DebugInfo::DebugInfoDialect",
    "mlir::NVVM::NVVMDialect",
    "mlir::ROCDL::ROCDLDialect",
    "mlir::index::IndexDialect",
  ];
}

def RewriteOpaqueTypes : Pass<"mogg-rewrite-opaque-types", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Rewrite !mo.opaque<\"simple\"> to !mo.opaque<\"fully.qualified\">";
  let description = [{
    Rewrites each `!mo.opaque<"simple_name">` to its fully-qualified name using
    the module's `mogg.opaque_type_mapping` (written by `mogg-import-packages`).
    Unmapped types are unchanged. Kept separate so callers that loaded packages
    elsewhere (e.g. `MAXG_addKernelPackage`) can copy the mapping and run only
    this step; see the `kernel-decls-pre-populated` pipeline option.
  }];
}

def StripKernelDecls : Pass<"mogg-strip-kernel-decls", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Remove mogg.kernel.decl and mogg.primitive.decl ops from a module";
  let description = [{
    Run after the last pass that reads the kernel registry; the decls are not
    part of the final output.
  }];
}

def VerifyKernels: Pass<"mogg-verify-kernels", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Verifies that kernels are well constructed";
  let description = [{
    Emits user-facing diagnostics for malformed `mogg.kernel.decl` signatures
    (missing `execute`, mismatched shape/execute inputs, ...).
  }];
}

def DumpKernels: Pass<"mogg-dump-kernels", "ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Prints the internal representation of kernels";
  let description = [{
    For debugging. Works on both `LIT` and `KGEN` kernels.
  }];
}

def ConformCallOperands
    : Pass<"mogg-conform-call-operands", "mlir::ModuleOp"> {
  let summary = "Conform `mogg` call operands to the callee's signature.";
  let description = [{
    Wraps scalar arguments in `mogg.scalar.create`, packs variadic runs into
    `mogg.tuple.create`, and wraps trait-bound arguments in
    `mogg.trait.create`. Kept out of `MAPToMOGG` so fusion IR stays simpler and
    each `::emitMojo` is a local, 1:1 lowering.
  }];

  let dependentDialects = [
    "M::MOGG::MOGGDialect",
  ];
}

#endif // GENERICML_GRAPHCOMPILER_MOGGDIALECT_MOGGPASSES_TD

#include "GraphCompiler/Conversion/OperandInference.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MODevices.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOOps.h"

namespace M::MOGG {

static bool opHasExtraOutputShapeArgument(Operation *op) {
  return isa<MO::Static::ReshapeOp, MO::Static::BroadcastToOp>(op);
}

static StringRef moOperationName(Operation *op) {
  if (auto customOp = dyn_cast<MO::CustomOp>(op))
    return customOp.getSymbol();

  return op->getName().getStringRef();
}

static std::optional<KernelDeclOperandVariant>
MOTypeToKernelDeclOperand(Type type) {
  auto iface = dyn_cast<MO::MOKernelOperandTypeInterface>(type);
  if (!iface)
    return std::nullopt;
  switch (iface.getKernelOperandKind()) {
  case MO::KernelOperandKind::Tensor:
    return KernelDeclTensorAdaptor{MOGG::IOSpec::InputTensor};
  case MO::KernelOperandKind::Buffer:
    return KernelDeclTensorAdaptor{MOGG::IOSpec::MutableInputTensor};
  case MO::KernelOperandKind::Scalar:
    return KernelDeclScalarAdaptor{};
  case MO::KernelOperandKind::Opaque:
    return KernelDeclOpaqueAdaptor{iface.getKernelOperandOpaqueName()};
  }
  return std::nullopt;
}

static ErrorOrSuccess
matchConvertedMOTypeToKernelDeclType(const KernelDeclOperandVariant &moType,
                                     const KernelDeclOperandVariant &kernelType,
                                     Type originalMOType,
                                     bool allowMutToImmut) {
  if (moType == kernelType)
    return success();

  // Reading mutable storage as an immutable snapshot is sound (the converse
  // is not); see `allowMutToImmut`.
  if (allowMutToImmut) {
    if (const auto *kernelTensor =
            std::get_if<KernelDeclTensorAdaptor>(&kernelType)) {
      const auto *moTensor = std::get_if<KernelDeclTensorAdaptor>(&moType);
      if (moTensor && moTensor->mut && !kernelTensor->mut)
        return success();
    }
  }

  if (std::holds_alternative<KernelDeclVariadicTensorAdaptor>(kernelType)) {
    const auto *tensorType = std::get_if<KernelDeclTensorAdaptor>(&moType);
    if (!tensorType)
      return Error("MO type is not a tensor type");

    const auto &kernelTensor =
        std::get<KernelDeclVariadicTensorAdaptor>(kernelType);
    if (kernelTensor.mut != tensorType->mut)
      return Error("Tensor type mismatch");

    return success();
  }

  if (std::holds_alternative<KernelDeclScalarAdaptor>(kernelType)) {
    const auto *tensorType = std::get_if<KernelDeclTensorAdaptor>(&moType);
    if (!tensorType)
      return Error("MO type is not a tensor type");

    if (tensorType->mut)
      return Error("Expected an immutable tensor type");

    // Opaque codegen handles (`!mogg.tensor`) carry no rank/device and were
    // validated upstream.
    if (auto shaped = dyn_cast<MO::MOShapedTypeInterface>(originalMOType))
      if (shaped.getRank() != 0)
        return Error("MO tensor type should have a rank of 0");

    if (isa<MO::MOHasDeviceTypeInterface>(originalMOType) &&
        !MO::isOnHost(originalMOType))
      return Error("Scalars should always be on the host CPU");

    return success();
  }

  return Error("Mismatched types");
}

template <bool matchOperands>
static ErrorOr<KernelDeclIndexToOperandAdaptorMapping>
matchOperandsOrResultsKernelDecl(ValueRange values,
                                 const KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor &adaptor,
                                 StringRef opName,
                                 bool hasSameVariadicOperandSize,
                                 bool hasExtraOutputShapeArgument,
                                 bool resultLeavesByValue,
                                 bool allowMutToImmut) {
  static const char *argumentKind = matchOperands ? "input" : "output";

  // Launch arguments (the `execute` device context, the `build_graph` graph
  // builder) have no MO operand; skipping them by kind lets one mapping serve
  // every function variant of a kernel.
  auto skipLaunchArgument =
      [](const llvm::SmallVector<KernelDeclOperandAdaptor> &operands,
         uint64_t &idx) -> std::optional<KernelDeclOperandAdaptor> {
    while (idx < operands.size()) {
      if (!operands[idx].isLaunchArgument())
        return operands[idx];
      ++idx;
    }
    return std::nullopt;
  };

  auto skipChainType = [](auto range, uint64_t &idx) -> std::optional<Type> {
    while (idx < range.size()) {
      if (!isa<MO::ChainType>(range[idx]))
        return range[idx];
      ++idx;
    }
    return std::nullopt;
  };

  const llvm::SmallVector<KernelDeclOperandAdaptor> &kernelOperands =
      matchOperands ? adaptor.inputArguments : adaptor.outputArguments;

  uint64_t mojoVariadicsCount = 0;
  uint64_t mojoNonVariadicsCount = 0;
  uint64_t moOperandsCount = 0;
  uint64_t moOpIndex = 0, kernelIndex = 0;

  while (true) {
    auto moType = skipChainType(values.getTypes(), moOpIndex);
    if (!moType.has_value())
      break;
    ++moOpIndex;
    ++moOperandsCount;
  }

  while (true) {
    auto kernelType = skipLaunchArgument(kernelOperands, kernelIndex);
    if (!kernelType.has_value())
      break;
    if (kernelType->isVariadicTensorType())
      ++mojoVariadicsCount;
    else
      ++mojoNonVariadicsCount;
    ++kernelIndex;
  }

  uint64_t variadicSize = 0;
  if (mojoVariadicsCount > 0) {
    if (mojoVariadicsCount > 1 && !hasSameVariadicOperandSize) {
      return Error(llvm::formatv(
          "Op '{}' binds {} variadic {} tensor arguments, but an op's flat "
          "operand list carries no group boundaries, so it can bind at most "
          "one per operand list. Several equal-sized groups require a "
          "dedicated op that implements SameVariadicOperandSize",
          opName, mojoVariadicsCount, argumentKind));
    }
    uint64_t totalVariadicOperands =
        moOperandsCount < mojoNonVariadicsCount
            ? 0
            : moOperandsCount - mojoNonVariadicsCount;
    if (totalVariadicOperands % mojoVariadicsCount != 0) {
      return Error(llvm::formatv(
          "Op '{}' has a total {} variadic operands divided "
          "between {} variadic kernel operands. They are expected "
          "to divide evenly",
          opName, totalVariadicOperands, mojoVariadicsCount));
    }
    variadicSize = totalVariadicOperands / mojoVariadicsCount;
  }

  KernelDeclIndexToOperandAdaptorMapping mapping;
  moOpIndex = 0, kernelIndex = 0;
  uint64_t currVariadicSize = 0;
  bool matchingVariadicTensor = false;

  while (true) {
    auto moType = skipChainType(values.getTypes(), moOpIndex);
    auto kernelType = skipLaunchArgument(kernelOperands, kernelIndex);

    if (!moType.has_value() || !kernelType.has_value())
      break;

    auto moTypeToKernelDeclOperand = MOTypeToKernelDeclOperand(*moType);
    if (!moTypeToKernelDeclOperand.has_value()) {
      return Error(
          llvm::formatv("Unsupported op argument type at index {}", moOpIndex));
    }

    auto errorOnMatch = matchConvertedMOTypeToKernelDeclType(
        *moTypeToKernelDeclOperand, kernelType->underlyingType, *moType,
        allowMutToImmut);

    if (errorOnMatch.isError()) {
      return Error(llvm::formatv(
          "Op '{}' {} at position {} does not match registered kernel operand "
          "at position {}: {} vs {}. Detail: {}",
          opName, argumentKind, moOpIndex,
          kernelType->sourceDescriptor->position, *moTypeToKernelDeclOperand,
          *kernelType, errorOnMatch.getError()));
    }

    mapping[moOpIndex] = *kernelType;

    if (kernelType->isVariadicTensorType()) {
      matchingVariadicTensor = true;
      if (++currVariadicSize == variadicSize) {
        matchingVariadicTensor = false;
        currVariadicSize = 0;
      }
    }

    ++moOpIndex;
    kernelIndex += !matchingVariadicTensor;
  }

  if (matchingVariadicTensor)
    skipLaunchArgument(kernelOperands, ++kernelIndex);

  bool moOpEnd = moOpIndex == values.size();
  bool kernelEnd = kernelIndex == kernelOperands.size();

  if (hasExtraOutputShapeArgument)
    return mapping;

  if (!kernelEnd) {
    return Error(llvm::formatv(
        "Could not provide all {} arguments to op '{}': missing operands "
        "starting from argument named '{}'",
        argumentKind, opName,
        kernelOperands[kernelIndex].sourceDescriptor->sourceName.str()));
  }

  if constexpr (matchOperands) {
    if (!moOpEnd) {
      return Error(
          llvm::formatv("Op '{}' has too many operands: operands starting "
                        "at position {} has no equivalent in kernel",
                        opName, moOpIndex));
    }
    return mapping;
  }

  auto moType = skipChainType(values.getTypes(), moOpIndex);

  // A by-ref result of unrecognized type (KernelDeclUnsupported) is treated as
  // absent. A by-value result has no entry in `values` to match.
  bool hasValidOutputResult =
      !resultLeavesByValue && adaptor.outputResult.has_value() &&
      !std::holds_alternative<KernelDeclUnsupportedAdaptor>(
          adaptor.outputResult->underlyingType);

  if (!moType.has_value() && !hasValidOutputResult)
    return mapping;

  if (moType.has_value() && !hasValidOutputResult) {
    return Error(llvm::formatv(
        "Op '{}' has too many results: results starting at position {} have no "
        "equivalent output argument or function result in kernel",
        opName, moOpIndex));
  }

  if (!moType.has_value() && hasValidOutputResult) {
    return Error(llvm::formatv(
        "Op '{}' is missing a result for kernel function result of type {}",
        opName, *adaptor.outputResult));
  }

  auto moTypeToKernelDeclOperand = MOTypeToKernelDeclOperand(*moType);
  if (!moTypeToKernelDeclOperand.has_value()) {
    return Error(
        llvm::formatv("Op '{}': Unsupported op result type at position {}",
                      opName, moOpIndex));
  }

  auto errorOnMatch = matchConvertedMOTypeToKernelDeclType(
      *moTypeToKernelDeclOperand, adaptor.outputResult->underlyingType, *moType,
      /*allowMutToImmut=*/false);
  if (errorOnMatch.isError()) {
    return Error(llvm::formatv(
        "Op '{}' output at position {} does not match kernel function result; "
        "op has {} but kernel has {}. Detail: {}",
        opName, moOpIndex, *moTypeToKernelDeclOperand, *adaptor.outputResult,
        errorOnMatch.getError()));
  }
  mapping[moOpIndex] = *adaptor.outputResult;

  return mapping;
}

ErrorOr<KernelDeclOperandMapping>
mapToKernelImplementation(ValueRange operands, ValueRange results,
                          const KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor &adaptor,
                          StringRef opName, bool hasSameVariadicOperandSize,
                          bool hasExtraOutputShapeArgument,
                          bool resultLeavesByValue, bool allowMutToImmut) {
  auto matchedInputsOrError = matchOperandsOrResultsKernelDecl<true>(
      operands, adaptor, opName, hasSameVariadicOperandSize,
      hasExtraOutputShapeArgument, /*resultLeavesByValue=*/false,
      allowMutToImmut);
  if (matchedInputsOrError.isError())
    return matchedInputsOrError.takeError();

  // Outputs are destination-passing (mutable); the mut->immut widening only
  // applies to read-only inputs.
  auto matchedOutputsOrError = matchOperandsOrResultsKernelDecl<false>(
      results, adaptor, opName, hasSameVariadicOperandSize,
      hasExtraOutputShapeArgument, resultLeavesByValue,
      /*allowMutToImmut=*/false);
  if (matchedOutputsOrError.isError())
    return matchedOutputsOrError.takeError();

  return KernelDeclOperandMapping{matchedInputsOrError.takeValue(),
                                  matchedOutputsOrError.takeValue()};
}

ErrorOr<KernelDeclOperandMapping>
mapMOOpToKernelImplementation(Operation *op,
                              const KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor &adaptor) {
  return mapToKernelImplementation(
      op->getOperands(), op->getResults(), adaptor, moOperationName(op),
      isa<MO::SameVariadicOperandSizeInterface>(op),
      opHasExtraOutputShapeArgument(op), /*resultLeavesByValue=*/false);
}
